messages:
Ibrahim: Heads-up — saw a jump in renewal nudges during the 02:00-03:00 UTC window, ~600 extra sends.
Sofia: saw dashboard spike. link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/outbound?filter=renewal-nudge
Chen: any recent cadence or cron changes?
Ibrahim: yes — a scheduled change for timezone handling was merged last night. suspect DST/daylight-savings rollover combined with cron TZ-less expression.
Rosa: logs show scheduler executed an extra run at 02:00 local time for EU regions. snippet: `cron: 0 2 * * *` (no TZ) 
ops-bot: ALERT: PLAYBOOK_SCHEDULER_DBL_RUN #1969000000 severity=high; extra_sends=612; affected_cohort=midmarket
Sofia: impact: 612 extra nudges, 18 accounts with renewals <30d. Need to avoid noisy outreach and owner confusion.
Chen: plan: 1) pause renewal-nudge automation for EU region 2) identify duplicates and suppress 3) notify AMs for 18 renewals 4) fix scheduler to use TZ-aware cron or UTC 5) add regression test.
Ibrahim: pausing automation scoped to region=eu: `playbook.pause(rule=renewal-nudge, region=eu)`
ops-bot: command acknowledged: playbook.pause succeeded.
Chen: running duplicate detection: `select account_id, count(*) from outbound where rule='renewal-nudge' and created_at between '2025-10-26T01:30' and '2025-10-26T03:15' group by 1 having count(*)>1` -> produced 612 duplicate rows across 142 accounts (csv exported).
Rosa: dry-run suppression in staging shows safe removal of duplicates, leaving canonical sends.
Sofia: owner DM template: "Heads-up — due to a scheduler timezone issue you may have received duplicate renewal nudges for <account>. We've suppressed duplicates and reverted scheduling for EU. Reply if you want us to pause outreach."
Ibrahim: deploying scheduler fix: change cron to UTC and add explicit tz field: `cron: 0 02 * * * tz: UTC` and add unit tests for DST transitions.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: scheduler-fix commit 7a1e, will canary in eu-west-1.
Chen: also adding a CI check that simulates DST rollovers and asserts no >0.2% duplicate_rate.
deploy-bot: canary succeeded, rolling to prod.
ops-bot: suppression job executed: suppressed=612 duplicates, failures=0.
Sofia: AMs for 18 renewals notified; 2 asked for executive summary, sent.
Rosa: follow-ups: 1) add alert if outbound_rate changes >0.5% within 15m 2) add scheduler lint rule requiring tz field 3) document DST runbook for playbook schedulers. I'll own documentation + owner comms.
Ibrahim: thanks team. posting postmortem draft to #customer-success-postmortems and closing thread. :white_check_mark:
